description: This file contains the implementation of ModuleConfigurationDaoImpl, which manages database operations related to IntegrationModule entities, such as retrieving module configurations by name or code in a Java Spring project using Querydsl.

classes.name: ModuleConfigurationDaoImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the DAO for managing IntegrationModule entities, extending generic DAO functionality and implementing specific retrieval methods.

methods.name: getModulesConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a list of IntegrationModule configurations filtered by the module name.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a single IntegrationModule entity based on its module code.
